en: Black‑and‑white interior view of an old-fashioned restaurant or inn. The room has neatly set tables with white tablecloths and wooden chairs. The walls are crowded with decorative items: clocks, framed pictures, plates, hunting tools, saws crossed in an X, and rustic household objects. Lace trim runs along the top of a long bench. In the background a doorway reveals another similarly furnished room. The style suggests a Central European, possibly Alpine, guesthouse or tavern.
